marked_enemy_covered_by_tower_count: {coverage_rule_text} How many towers cover the marked enemy?
{coverage_rule_text} Count the towers whose range rings include the marked enemy.
{coverage_rule_text} What is the number of towers covering the marked enemy?
{coverage_rule_text} Report how many tower range rings contain the marked enemy.
{coverage_rule_text} Count only the towers that cover the marked enemy.
covered_path_segment_count: {coverage_rule_text} How many path nodes are covered?
{coverage_rule_text} Count the path nodes covered by one or more towers.
{coverage_rule_text} What is the number of covered path nodes?
{coverage_rule_text} Report how many path nodes lie inside at least one tower range ring.
{coverage_rule_text} Count only the path nodes covered by at least one tower.
